title: stabilize-slo-enforcer-backoff-regional-failover-hotfix
author: Alyssa Chen
description:
Hotfix to stabilize SLO enforcer backoff and regional failover thrashing observed during the 2026-02-19 incident. Root cause: the enforcer's backoff queue used non-deterministic ordering under high concurrency which allowed rapid successive backoff events to reorder and trigger cross-region failover cascades. This PR introduces a deterministic priority queue for backoff ordering, adds a region-specific cooldown window, and updates the circuit breaker state machine with an explicit 'DEGRADED' state to avoid immediate full failover. Also includes temporary prod threshold overrides and additional metrics/tracing to speed future debugging.

Changes include:
- deterministic backoff ordering (priority by failure score, then time)
- per-region cooldown (regionCooldownMs) and global cooldown floor
- circuit breaker: add DEGRADED state and gradual capacity reduction policy
- prod overrides to raise threshold for 2h during rollout
- metrics: cb_transition_total, cb_degraded_duration_seconds, backoff_queue_size
- tests: unit and integration tests covering ordering and cooldown

Checklist:
- [x] unit tests
- [x] integration test run
- [x] manual canary on us-west-2
- [x] added metrics and tracing hooks
- [x] documented incident notes and rollout steps
